ApproveFotaUpdate.description_en: Enables OTA updates for cloud computers

ChangePassword.description_en: Changes the password of a user account

DescribeGlobalDesktops.description_en: Query detailed information about cloud desktops across multiple regions. You can query only regions in the Chinese mainland (excluding Nanjing – Local Region – Shutting Down)
DescribeGlobalDesktops.description_zh: 查询多个地域的云电脑详细信息。目前仅支持中国内地对应的地域查询（不包含：南京-本地地域-关停中）

DescribeOfficeSites.description_en: Query the details of an office network
DescribeOfficeSites.description_zh: 查询办公网络的详细信息

DescribeSnapshots.description_en: Queries the snapshots that are created based on a cloud computer and the details of the snapshots
DescribeSnapshots.description_zh: 查询一台云电脑的快照列表和快照详细信息

DescribeUserResources.description_en: Queries the list of resources owned by a user

GetCloudDriveServiceMountToken.description_en: Obtain the logon credential for Enterprise File Gateway
GetCloudDriveServiceMountToken.description_zh: 获取企业网盘登录凭证

GetConnectionTicket.description_en: Obtains a connection ticket for a cloud computer

RebootDesktops.description_en: You can restart one or more cloud desktops
RebootDesktops.description_zh: 重启一台或者多台云电脑

ResetSnapshot.description_en: Restores the data of a disk from a snapshot
ResetSnapshot.description_zh: 恢复快照对应的磁盘数据

StartDesktops.description_zh: 启动一台或者多台云电脑

StopDesktops.description_en: Stops one or more cloud computers
StopDesktops.description_zh: 停止一台或者多台云电脑

UnbindUserDesktop.description_en: Unbinds end users from cloud computers

VerifyCredential.description_en: Validates credentials to lock on-premises sessions on clients
VerifyCredential.description_zh: 验证客户端本地会话解锁的凭证
